H1.statement: SCP group-averaged coverage < 0.85 on at least one shift task

H2.statement: GC-D group-averaged coverage in [0.87, 0.95] on every task with >= 10 training groups

H3.statement: Diagnostic normalisation lowers interval score vs. absolute scores (GC-D vs G-W-A)

test: two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank (exact if <=25 non-zero pairs), unit = held-out group (or outer fold when a fold holds out several groups: mango_population, ossl_lucas_campaign), per-group values averaged over seeds; Holm correction across comparators within task; effect size = matched-pairs rank-biserial correlation (negative = GC-D lower)
